summary: Rewrote VillageQuestBoardView: Create factory kept; Bind(DailyMissionBoard, PlayerWallet) renders a 'Daily Missions' title and per-mission rows with description, progress/target, and a Claim button. The button is interactable only when the mission is complete and unclaimed. Claim adds gold to the wallet. It re-renders on board.Changed and unsubscribes in OnDestroy. Unbound, it shows 'No missions today.'
